# SecretScan

> SecretScan is an iPhone and iPad privacy app that uses on-device OCR and deterministic pattern checks to find likely passwords, recovery codes, seed phrases, API keys, payment details, IDs, and other sensitive text left in screenshots and photos.

SecretScan does not upload Photos or extracted OCR text to SecretScan servers. Findings require human review because pattern detection can miss content and can produce false positives. Deleting an image does not revoke a credential; users should rotate or revoke exposed passwords, tokens, keys, or recovery material through the issuing service.

## Practical guides

- [Sensitive screenshot exposure check](https://mityapolianskii.github.io/secretscan-app-store-pages/screenshot-exposure-check.html): answer six local Yes, No, or Unsure questions to prioritize revocation, redaction, deletion, and Photos permission cleanup without entering a secret or uploading a photo.
  - [Español](https://mityapolianskii.github.io/secretscan-app-store-pages/es/revisar-captura-sensible.html)
  - [Deutsch](https://mityapolianskii.github.io/secretscan-app-store-pages/de/geteilten-screenshot-pruefen.html)
  - [Русский](https://mityapolianskii.github.io/secretscan-app-store-pages/ru/proverit-otpravlennyy-skrinshot.html)
- [Search screenshots by text on iPhone](https://mityapolianskii.github.io/secretscan-app-store-pages/search-screenshots-by-text-iphone.html): use built-in Photos or Spotlight search when the exact visible text is known.
- [Sensitive screenshot privacy checklist](https://mityapolianskii.github.io/secretscan-app-store-pages/iphone-sensitive-screenshot-checklist.html): manually audit risky categories, Photos permissions, deletion, and credential rotation.
  - [Español](https://mityapolianskii.github.io/secretscan-app-store-pages/es/eliminar-capturas-sensibles-iphone.html)
  - [Deutsch](https://mityapolianskii.github.io/secretscan-app-store-pages/de/sensible-screenshots-iphone-finden-loeschen.html)
  - [Русский](https://mityapolianskii.github.io/secretscan-app-store-pages/ru/nayti-udalit-chuvstvitelnye-skrinshoty-iphone.html)
- [Check which apps can access your iPhone photos](https://mityapolianskii.github.io/secretscan-app-store-pages/check-which-apps-access-iphone-photos.html): review Photos permissions, recent access in App Privacy Report, and the limits of changing device access.
- [Redact sensitive information in an iPhone screenshot](https://mityapolianskii.github.io/secretscan-app-store-pages/redact-sensitive-information-iphone-screenshot.html): use built-in Markup carefully, distinguish opaque coverage from highlighting, and verify the copy before sharing.
  - [Español](https://mityapolianskii.github.io/secretscan-app-store-pages/es/ocultar-datos-captura-iphone.html)
  - [Deutsch](https://mityapolianskii.github.io/secretscan-app-store-pages/de/iphone-screenshot-private-daten-abdecken.html)
  - [Русский](https://mityapolianskii.github.io/secretscan-app-store-pages/ru/skryt-lichnye-dannye-skrinshot-iphone.html)
- [Remove location from iPhone photos](https://mityapolianskii.github.io/secretscan-app-store-pages/remove-location-from-iphone-photos.html): review or remove GPS metadata with built-in Photos controls; SecretScan does not scan location metadata.
- [Find API keys in iPhone screenshots](https://mityapolianskii.github.io/secretscan-app-store-pages/scan-api-keys-in-screenshots.html): developer-focused screenshot audit and remediation guidance.
- [Find recovery codes and seed phrases in photos](https://mityapolianskii.github.io/secretscan-app-store-pages/find-recovery-codes-in-photos.html): account-recovery and wallet-material cleanup guidance.
- [Find password screenshots and photos on iPhone](https://mityapolianskii.github.io/secretscan-app-store-pages/find-passwords-in-iphone-photos.html): distinguish protected Passwords-app records from photographed credentials, then find and clean up image copies.
- [Find credit card screenshots and photos on iPhone](https://mityapolianskii.github.io/secretscan-app-store-pages/find-credit-card-photos-iphone.html): use built-in text search or a private checksum-and-context scan, then distinguish routine cleanup from possible exposure that needs issuer action.
- [Find passport and ID photos on iPhone](https://mityapolianskii.github.io/secretscan-app-store-pages/find-passport-id-photos-iphone.html): review old identity-document copies with Photos Utilities, exact-text search, private pattern checks, and deliberate cleanup.

## Product boundaries

- SecretScan is not a cloud vault, antivirus, password manager, or identity-theft service.
- The free version scans screenshots. An optional one-time Lifetime Pro purchase expands scanning and cleanup limits.
- OCR and detection run on the device. Minimal product-validation analytics are described in the privacy policy and exclude Photos, OCR text, finding details, categories, counts, and Photos identifiers.
- The developer and copyright holder is Dmytro Polianskyi.
